event_identity_family.proof: Both account/zero the exact event-task work allocation (old96B, Golden112B), register priority15 with event update/destroy callbacks, associate the separate event-load task, set major/minor event IDs with third ID0, request its load and set primary state0. The old unused third constructor argument is not a new Golden parameter.
event_identity_family.old_query_meaning: Search evtEvent, then fall back to evtLookupTask2853c0, whose actual literal is evtEdit. Despite the old comment/name, this does NOT create a task.
event_identity_family.query_limit: The complete evtEvent identity is shared by registration and named search. New higher-level queries add availability gates and return booleans; do not substitute their boolean return for the old task handle. evtEditLoad getter13c830 and work getter13c800 are separate namespaces/roles, not asserted matches for the old event-or-editor handle wrapper.

event_BF_label_family.proof: Both action handlers return the event-status predicate for action0; on action2 require command frame==requested frame, set flag0x80000, format the complete BF path from current event major/minor plus command suffix+0x41, lazily create the script-loader context if missing, and submit priority15 with the extra command mode. Both use a256B filename buffer.
event_BF_label_family.nso_operand_evidence: Ordinary1442bc loads signed16 suffix at command+14 and1442c0 adds0x41; the mode at+16 is passed to the request. The current IDs are at event context+ad8/+adc; these are evidence, not guest offsets.
event_BF_label_family.limits: No ASCII suffix clamp, fake default, record-layout identity or BF-bytecode compatibility is inferred. Preserve the actual operand domain and one-context lifetime.

filter_identity_family.proof: Both old constructors decode event filter records, build direct or copied/reference-aware filters, allocate a small task work record (old16B, Golden24B), store filter handle plus progression value and register the same priority15 child with update/free callbacks. The copied family includes types1/2/3/5; its type3 path has the independently confirmed44B template anchors65848484,3ba3d70a,3e051eb8 and percent-normalized weight. Golden shares packed-record parser147430 and stores64-bit filter handles.
filter_identity_family.selector_delta: Old direct selector0 builds type1; Golden direct wrapper accepts1 for that role. Both also handle2. This is not a claim of identical entry selector numbering or parameter-buffer layout.

rare_template_context.status: Context anchors only; this separate table row is not changed.

motion_identity_family.proof: The complete family includes named destroy, per-resource queue flush, speed motion, timed motion and explicit position/angle motion. Constructors find or create one priority15 manager task, allocate manager userdata4->8B and queued records76->88B, copy the same44B parameter packet, and store the selected dispatch pointer. Speed/timed variants remove prior motion3 entries for the same16-bit resource ID; explicit placement accepts four extra settings and marks its record when present. Flush removes matching resource nodes; Golden adds motion-specific finalization and is not declared behaviorally identical.
motion_identity_family.pivotal_ABI: Ordinary1490cc loads manager userdata into x6 and1490d0 stores its owner before registering the task;1490ec sets priority15. Worker prototypes omit this work argument, so they are not authoritative.
motion_identity_family.dispatch_context: Old dispatch pointer table0063c930 and Golden763a80 are related context only. No complete motion-dispatch table/source admission or timing/interpolation equivalence is claimed by a task-name proof.
